sources.title: 410 IAC 16.2-3.1-12, Transfer and discharge rights (excerpt from the Department of Health's published Article 16.2)
sources.source_date: rule history line ends readopted filed Nov 13, 2019
sources.notes: The Department of Health publishes Article 16.2 as one 3.4 MB PDF; the page reads 410 IAC 16.2-3.1-12, so the slice runs from that section's heading to the start of section 13. Anchors proposed mechanically by tools/propose-slice.py from the standing packet's own span and confirmed by the checker, not read off the page by eye. The running heads and page numbers inside the range are the document's own and are left in place.

sources.notes: Server-rendered; plain curl with a browser user-agent returns the whole document.
